name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail lost in upscaling by using depth maps, giving a 0.7% quality bump in tests—better than standard upscalers. The trade-off is a 12% slower render time, but EXCAVA’s output quality gains outweigh speed for now.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it targets resolution, not identity—RealVisXL already locks faces but ignores EXCAVA’s full frame, leaving backgrounds soft. Instead, test InstantX-ComfyUI’s face-detail branch (if it exists) or swap to a model like Juggernaut-XL that preserves both identity and depth; run a blind A/B test with 50 samples—if face fidelity improves by 0.5% without a 15%+ speed hit, it’s worth it.
